other_conditions: Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Must not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS), or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Must not be an income tax payer
Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab or a family member of such a worker
Member must be depositing contribution to the Board regularly
Applicant must have undergone general surgery for himself or any family member
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹50,000 or actual expenses, whichever is less, for general surgery of the beneficiary or family members.
